name.description: Short name, lower case with hyphens. In a scope, the same name updates the note.

description.description: One line that says what the note is for. Sessions see it in their start text.

body.description: The note itself. One fact or rule per note.

scope.description: Who sees it: your agent (default), your project, or every session. Only the owner and the CTO write owner; an agent's owner write is refused.

kind.description: feedback: how to work. fact: something true about the work. reference: where to look.

created.description: False when an existing note of that name was updated.

similar.description: Up to 3 similar notes. Merge into one of them instead of keeping both.
